metadata.description: Erlangen Cricket Club members' app: match and practice availability, attendance and squad selection.

week.preview: Preview with sample data, shown as {date}

banner.allDoneText: You have answered for everything this week.

reason.title: Not going?
reason.description: Tell your captain why. Only you, your captain and the Board see it.
reason.label: Reason
reason.motion: ECC league matches come first: not going to play tennis- or tape-ball cricket is not allowed (motion 2026/03).

attendance.title: Practice attendance
attendance.met: You can be selected. These practices count for {day}'s match.
attendance.needs: Attend {needed} of the next {of, plural, one {practice} other {# practices}} to be selected.
attendance.out: You can't be selected for this match: 2 of the last 4 practices are needed (motion 2023/01).
attendance.notActive: The 2-of-4 rule starts once 4 practices have taken place.

week.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: With your club account: the same email and password as on the club website.
signIn.help: No account yet, or forgot your password? Ask the Board for a personal link.
signIn.error: Signing in is not possible right now. Please try again.

rejected.credentials: Email or password is not right.
rejected.locked: Too many attempts: your account is locked for a while. Try again later.

errors.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.

unlinked.title: Almost there
unlinked.text: Your account is not linked to a player yet. Ask the Board to link it, then your week appears here.

noSquad.title: No team yet
noSquad.text: You are not in a team squad yet. The Board assigns you to ECC I or ECC II.

quiet.title: A quiet week
quiet.text: No matches or practices for your team this week.

weekState.saveFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Please try again.

team.title: Your team
team.preview: Preview with sample data, shown as {date}

quiet.title: A quiet week
quiet.text: {team} has no match or practice this week.

notCaptain.title: Captains only
notCaptain.text: These screens are for team captains. Your week has everything you need.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.text: This is not one of your team's matches or practices.

checkIn.walkIn: Ticking someone who had not said Going records them as a walk-in.
checkIn.saved: Attendance saved. Players see it in their week.
checkIn.failed: The check-in could not be saved. Please try again.
checkIn.notYetText: The check-in opens on {day}, the practice day.
checkIn.cancelledText: Cancelled practices don't count for attendance.

hint.playing: Tap players to fill the XI.
hint.reserve: Squad complete: tap to add reserves, or submit.

reason.no-show: Sits out: missed the last match (motion 2023/10)

twelfthSheet.title: 11 selected
twelfthSheet.none: Nobody else can be picked. Ask the Board for help.

squad.incomplete: Pick 11 players and a 12th man to submit.

banner.submitted: Submitted to the Board. Only the Board can reopen it for changes.
banner.returnedNoNote: Returned by the Board. Please check it and submit again.
banner.approved: Approved and announced. Only the Board can change it now.

errors.invalid: This squad breaks a club rule. Reload the page and check it.
errors.unauthorized: Only the team's captain can submit its squad.
errors.error: The squad could not be submitted. Please try again.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.text: This page could not be loaded. Please try again.

board.title: Squads
board.preview: Preview with sample data, shown as {date}

quiet.title: A quiet week
quiet.text: No club team has a match this week.

notBoard.title: Board only
notBoard.text: Approving squads, deadlines and exceptions are for the Board.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.text: This is not a match of one of the club's teams.

squad.title: Squad
squad.empty: The captain has not picked a squad yet.

sendBackSheet.title: Send back
sendBackSheet.description: The squad opens again for the captain, who sees your note.
sendBackSheet.label: Note to the captain
sendBackSheet.required: Please write a note for the captain.

deadline.title: Availability closes
deadline.hint: Currently {when}. Extend it if players need longer to answer.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.hint: Going players a club rule is against. Allow one to make them selectable for this match only.

errors.invalid: That did not work. Reload the page and try again.
errors.not-allowed: The squad has changed in the meantime. Reload the page.
errors.unauthorized: Only the Board can do this.
errors.error: That could not be saved. Please try again.
